---
title: "About"
---

My name is Anthony Doll and I recently graduated from the University of Virgina with a degree in mathematics. I am currently taking a gap year before pursuing a PhD in math at Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland, Ohio. My main interests are in stable homotopy theory, and I prefer the computational side over the categorical side. I also really enjoy algebra and hope to deepen my understanding of algebraic geometry, representation theory, and algebraic number theory as I move forward. In my senior year of college, I completed aa Distinguished Majors Thesis on cohomology operations with applications towards computations of the stable homotopy groups of spheres under the guidance of Professor J.D. Quigley. If you're interested, you can find my thesis [here](https://doi.org/10.18130/xz15-sw63){target="_blank"}.
